about.title: About
about.lead: Research taught me to ask better questions. Engineering taught me to ship the answers.
about.p1: I started in 2009 as a research intern at UFPB. From there I worked in applied R&D with industry partners such as Dell EMC, Ingenico and Nice, taught computer science at three institutions, and completed a PhD in Computer Science at UFCG in 2022.
about.p2: Then the work moved from code to teams. I coordinated engineering and led product and data at Gria, then ran the data team and later the Data & AI unit at Techlead IT Solutions. In January 2026 I founded Borborema Tech, where I work on Data & AI projects, platforms and governance.

expertise.title: Tech Stack &
expertise.intro: My work spans software engineering, data platforms and applied AI. Technologies are grouped by recency and emphasis, and each one links to the role that shows it.
expertise.helpBody: Labels reflect recency and emphasis in my career record, not a measured mastery score or a ranking of ability. The five-segment bars repeat that grouping visually: they are provisional and derived from my LinkedIn profile until I set individual levels. “Core Expertise” marks tools tied to my most recent roles; “Project Experience” marks tools I used in earlier professional and research roles; “Earlier Experience” marks older or more specialised work. Each technology links to the roles where it appears, and a few come from my profile summary without a specific role. The grouping is provisional and based on my résumé, not on a test.
